title: Quercetin Simultaneously Treats Skeletal Fluorosis and Kashin-Beck Disease by Modulating HIF-1 and Ferroptosis Signaling Pathways.
authors: Liu, Bin; Wang, Yan; Zhu, Jingyuan; Huang, Hui; Chen, Ruiqin; Yu, Fangfang; Zhou, Guoyu; Ba, Yue
one_liner_zh: 该文研究槲皮素通过HIF-1和铁死亡通路治疗氟骨症与大骨节病，虽用分子对接和MD模拟，但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: Excessive fluoride exposure can lead to skeletal fluorosis (SF), and selenium deficiency is one of the important pathogenic factors of Kashin-Beck disease (KBD). Although the pathogenic factors of these two diseases vary, there are many similarities in their pathogenic mechanisms on skeletal and articular cartilage lesions. There are currently no specific drugs for either disease, and investigating their shared pathogenic mechanisms may facilitate the development of new drugs for the treatment. This study found through bioinformatics technology that the HIF-1 signaling pathway and ferroptosis pathway might exert significant effects in both SF and KBD. Targeted small molecule drug prediction was conducted for the above two signaling pathways, and quercetin was screened as the best candidate therapeutic drug. Meanwhile, molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulations once again validated our screening results. In summary, quercetin may alleviate the symptoms of SF and KBD by regulating the HIF-1 signaling pathway and the ferroptosis pathway. In other words, it can attain the objective of treating two diseases simultaneously with one drug. This will provide new theoretical references for the treatment of comorbidity.
abstract_zh: 过量氟暴露可导致氟骨症（skeletal fluorosis, SF），而硒缺乏是克山病（Kashin-Beck disease, KBD）的重要致病因素之一。尽管这两种疾病的致病因素不同，但其在骨骼和关节软骨病变的致病机制上存在诸多相似之处。目前这两种疾病均无特效药物，探究其共同致病机制可能有助于开发新的治疗药物。本研究通过生物信息学技术发现，HIF-1信号通路和铁死亡通路可能在SF和KBD中发挥重要作用。针对上述两条信号通路进行了靶向小分子药物预测，并筛选出槲皮素（quercetin）作为最佳候选治疗药物。同时，分子对接和分子动力学模拟再次验证了我们的筛选结果。总之，槲皮素可能通过调控HIF-1信号通路和铁死亡通路来缓解SF和KBD的症状，换言之，它能实现一药同治两病的目标。这将为共病的治疗提供新的理论参考。
